name: Pune · Bibwewadi & VIT
description: About 4 × 4 km of south Pune, Maharashtra, around Vishwakarma Institute of Technology (VIT), Bibwewadi: every mapped street and building footprint from OpenStreetMap.

transformations: Converted 1,652 OpenStreetMap ways into 2,636 intersections and 3,103 street segments (203.69 km).
324 one-way street segments (from 115 ways) may only be driven in the mapped direction. Routing defaults to directed mode.
Split 11 closed loops at the middle node so that no street starts and ends at the same intersection.
Dropped 19 disconnected pieces of network (3.79 km); kept the largest connected network.

Respecting one-way rules, 197 street segments (180 intersections) cannot be driven as part of a closed route from the main network, usually because a one-way street leaves the selected area. Enlarge the area or treat one-way streets as two-way to cover them.
Projected to a local equirectangular frame centred on 18.46300°N, 73.86900°E (x east, y south, metres); stored to 0.1 m.
Building footprints validated (closed, ≥ 3 distinct points, area ≥ 1 m², not self-intersecting); 0 rejected; 66 with their centroid outside the region dropped; 0 duplicates across tiles removed.
Turn restrictions: 0 mapped onto segments; 0 not supported.
estimates: Building heights: 1 from the OSM height tag, 11 from building:levels × 3 m (storey height is an assumption), 7130 ESTIMATED for visual context only (no height or levels in OSM): levels from the building type where it implies one, otherwise from footprint area (< 40 m² → 1, < 120 → 2, < 400 → 3, < 1,200 → 4, else 5), × 3 m. Estimated heights are not measurements.
limitations: Building multipolygon relations (courtyard buildings mapped as relations) are not included; simple building ways are.
OpenStreetMap completeness varies; unmapped streets and buildings are absent, not "empty".
Tiles overlap at their borders; 1,858 street elements and 213 building elements returned by more than one tile were merged.
Footpaths, cycleways and other non-vehicular ways were not acquired; walking and cycling routes use the road network.
Focus point: Nominatim search 'Vishwakarma Institute of Technology Pune' → OSM way 213874316 (2026-10-19).
